summary: The proof correctly establishes all five assertions. The minimizing-halfspace perturbation works in the ambient space even for lower-dimensional supports; the cap and maximality arguments preserve all boundary atoms; the convexity, exposed-vertex, and log-concave extension arguments cover degenerate supports; the integral and atomic inequalities are exact; and the midpoint-parity depth estimate, differential tail bound, moment bound, and box sharpness calculation have the stated hypotheses and constants.
